summary: Completed comprehensive RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) testing for Lumix production management system. All 6 requested features tested and working correctly. The implementation includes mode selection screen, role-based menu filtering, route protection, and proper access denial for unauthorized users.
passed_tests: Mode selection screen appears on login with 'Laboratório' and 'Produção' buttons
Login with Laboratório mode (laboratoriolumix@outlook.com / Lumix2002) - full menu access granted
Login with Produção mode (teste@teste.com / password) - only 'Contagem' and 'Amostras' visible
Role badge (Laboratório/Produção) appears correctly in sidebar with appropriate colors
Route protection: Produção user redirected to /counting when trying to access /dashboard directly
Route protection: Produção user redirected to /counting when trying to access /products directly
'Voltar para seleção de modo' button works correctly - returns to mode selection screen
Non-authorized user (teste@teste.com) trying Laboratório mode gets denied with toast message and forced to Produção mode
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC implementation is clean and follows best practices
Role stored in localStorage for persistence across sessions
Menu filtering in Layout.js correctly uses role-based array filtering
RoleRoute component in App.js properly protects routes
AuthContext properly validates email for Laboratório access
context_for_next_testing_agent: RBAC implementation is complete and working. Laboratório mode grants full access to all menu items. Produção mode restricts access to only Contagem and Amostras. Route protection prevents direct URL access to restricted pages. The authorized email for Laboratório is laboratoriolumix@outlook.com.
